msg: The gnomes with the brown and grey-ish hats usually give a consistently high yield (ranging from 0-9). Choose these gnomes until the yield drops a few times in a row. Then start choosing the gnomes with the more colourful hats. These can still yield quite a lot, but aren't as consistently high. When these stop giving many high numbers go back to choosing the grey/brown-hatted gnomes. If after a few goes these still aren't yielding high numbers then go back to choosing a few of the colourful gnomes.
